units.source_text: 果如所说，源氏公子于十六日月白风清之夜来到了这邸宅里。

en.t: Just as had been said, Prince Genji came to this residence on the sixteenth, on a night of bright moonlight and clear wind.
Dainagon no Myobu said, "What unfortunate timing!

units.source_text: 这种月色朦胧的春夜，弹起琴来声音不清朗的。”

en.t: On a spring night like this, with the moonlight so hazy, the sound of the koto will not ring clearly."

units.source_text: 公子说：“不妨，你去劝她弹吧，略弹几声也好。

en.t: The prince said, "No matter. Go and urge her to play; even a few notes would do.

units.source_text: 既然来了，空空地回去多么扫兴啊！”

en.t: Since I have come all this way, how disappointing it would be to go back with nothing!"

units.source_text: 大辅命妇想起自己的房间太简陋，要公子躲在里面等候，不好意思，并且对他不起。

en.t: Dainagon no Myobu thought of how shabby her own room was, and felt embarrassed and sorry to make the prince hide there and wait.

units.source_text: 然而也顾不得，便独自往常陆亲王小姐所居的正殿那里去了。

en.t: Yet she could not worry about that now, and went alone toward the main hall where the daughter of Prince Hitachi lived.

units.source_text: 一看，格子窗还开着，小姐正观赏庭中月下的梅花。

en.t: When she looked, the lattice shutters were still open, and the young lady was gazing at the plum blossoms in the moonlit garden.

units.source_text: 她觉得机会很好，便开言道：“我想起您的琴弹得极好，就乘这良夜来此，想饱饱耳福。

en.t: Thinking this was an excellent opportunity, she began, "I remembered how beautifully you play the koto, so I came on this fine night hoping to listen to my heart's content.

units.source_text: 平时公事繁忙，匆匆出入，不能静心拜听，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: Usually I am busy with official duties and come and go in haste, so I have never been able to listen calmly, which I have deeply regretted."

units.source_text: 这小姐说：“琴要弹给像你那样的知音者听才好。

en.t: The young lady said, "The koto is best played for someone like you, who truly understands its sound.

units.source_text: 不过你是出入宫闱的人，我的琴怕不中听吧。”

en.t: But since you move in and out of the palace, I fear my playing may not please your ear."
With that, she had the koto brought over.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇担心：不知源氏公子听了作何感想？

en.t: Dainagon no Myobu worried: what would Prince Genji think when he heard it?
Her heart was restless with anxiety.
